name: SoftBank Group Corp.
summary: SoftBank Group Corp. provides telecommunication services in Japan and internationally. It operates through Investment Business of Holding Companies, SoftBank Vision Funds, SoftBank, AI Computing Business, and Other segments. The company offers mobile services and broadband services to retail customers; mobile communications and solutions services to enterprise customers; ICT services products to enterprise customers; media, advertising and commerce services; and payment and financial services. It also offers design of semiconductor IP, chips, and related technology; development and sale of semiconductor chips; and sale of software tools and provision of related services.
